tooltip.darkrifts.rift_blade.1: Tears rifts in the sky into the dark mirror of the world.
tooltip.darkrifts.rift_blade.2: Hold Right Click, look up and drag your view to draw a rift. Sneak + Right Click on a rift closes it.
message.darkrifts.stroke_too_short: The rift fizzles out... drag further.
message.darkrifts.no_room: There is no room for a rift here.
message.darkrifts.cant_close: This return rift cannot be closed.
message.darkrifts.dimension_missing: The rift leads nowhere (%s is missing).
message.darkrifts.not_your_seal: Only the one who sealed this player can lift the seal
ability.darkrifts.rift.desc: Hold Right Click and drag your view to tear a rift
ability.darkrifts.spikes.desc: Rifts tear open around you and spikes burst out
ability.darkrifts.pull.desc: Pulls enemies into a point in front of you
ability.darkrifts.cloak.desc: Invisible, shielded, nearby mobs go blind
tooltip.darkrifts.rift_blade.3: Press R to choose an ability.
ability.darkrifts.wave.desc: A line of rifts races forward, spikes bursting out
ability.darkrifts.slash.desc: A long cut through the air that wounds everything on it
ability.darkrifts.strike.desc: A rift opens on your target and a bolt falls through
ability.darkrifts.drain.desc: Steals the life of nearby enemies
ability.darkrifts.shield.desc: Throws back and hurts everything that comes close
ability.darkrifts.seal.desc: Seals the target in the void. A sealed player respawns there forever
